description: List service trade categories from the combined EB catalog, including numeric EBOPS and SDMX codes. Returns category codes, descriptions, and parent codes. Filter by keyword (e.g. "transport", "financial", "travel") or browse direct children of a parent code. Use the returned id as service_code in comtrade_get_services_trade. Code 3 is transport; SA is manufacturing services.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return; above 500 returns all matching categories.

parent_code.description: Return direct children of this EB category code. Example: "3" for transport sub-categories, or "3.1" for sea transport sub-categories.

query.description: Keyword or category code prefix to filter results. Examples: "transport", "SA", "financial services". Omit to list all EB categories.

name: comtrade_list_service_categories

categories.description: EB service categories matching the query.

items.description: A service trade category from the combined EB catalog.

id.description: EBOPS category code (use as service_code in trade queries).

parent.description: Parent EBOPS category code, if any.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no results found or results are truncated.

totalMatches.description: Total matching categories before limit truncation.

truncated.description: True when categories were capped at the limit (totalMatches exceeds shown).

title: List Service Trade Categories (EB)
